answer_1.quote: This paper presents DALE, a novel generative data augmentation framework for low-resource legal NLP.

answer_2.quote: We report micro-averaged F1 scores averaged across 3 runs for 3 random seeds.

answer_4.quote: Each augmentation was marked by a law student on 3 parameters: (1) If the augmentation is coherent, (2) If it adds new plausible context, and (3) if it is label-consistent and matches the underlying data distribution.
